hero.title: Custom software that organizes and grows your business
hero.subtitle: We design tailored systems that automate your sales, inventory, payments and reports, so you get your time back and make decisions with data — not guesses.
hero.result: Less manual work, full control of your operation and clear profits.

audience.title: This service is for you if…
audience.subtitle: If you recognize yourself in any of these, we can help.
items: You run a small business and still track everything in notebooks or Excel.
You lose customers or money to messy sales, payments or debts.
You don't clearly know how much you earn or which product sells best.
You manage your inventory or donations by hand.
You want clear reports without spending hours adding things up.
You want to grow without hiring more admin staff.
You need a system built for your process, not a generic template.
You want someone close who supports you with real help.

faq.title: What people usually ask us
faq.subtitle: If your question isn't here, message us on WhatsApp and we'll reply.

items.question: How long does it take to build my system?
items.answer: It depends on scope. A simple system can take 2 to 4 weeks, and a complete one 6 to 12 weeks. In the proposal we give you a clear schedule with dates.

items.question: What do I need to buy or have?
items.answer: We can work with the equipment you already own. If you're missing something, we advise you and also sell you the hardware (CPU, screen, keyboard, mouse and more) with warranty.

items.question: How soon can I see results?
items.answer: From the first week you'll notice more order and control. The biggest results — saved time and data-driven decisions — show up in the first month of steady use.

items.question: Do you work only in Maracaibo?
items.answer: Our base is in Maracaibo, Zulia, and we can serve businesses across Venezuela remotely.

items.question: Is the system custom or a template?
items.answer: 100% custom to your process. We don't adapt your business to a software — we adapt the software to your business.

items.question: Do you offer support after delivery?
items.answer: Yes. Every project includes support and follow-up, and we offer ongoing maintenance plans.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: We work in milestones: a deposit to start and the rest on delivery. We coordinate everything on WhatsApp.

items.question: What happens with my data?
items.answer: Your data is yours and stays secure. We follow good practices for backups and access control.
